Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

At this year's career day, two students' parents had early morning slots. One, a judge, the other a taxi driver. The taxi driver unfortunately had to cancel at the last minute, which surprised no one given they never come to any school events, even parent-teacher meetings. The presentation by the judge was a delight, though! Who involves themself in their kids education?
A. The judge
B. Can't be determined
C. The taxi driver
